motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Menu add colour/scale, quantity hover, navigation underline and save hover.

motion.name: link-gap
motion.purpose: Menu/story action gaps and closing-action gap, respectively.

motion.name: basket-entrance
motion.purpose: Horizontal entrance of the native modal; skipped with reduced motion.

motion.name: added-feedback
motion.purpose: Temporary filled add state and count scale feedback (1.18 → 1).

motion.name: filter-rows
motion.purpose: Dietary-filter changes; skipped with reduced motion.

motion.name: scene-scrub
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked progress under native scrolling across the 700svh journey.

motion.name: camera-orbit
motion.purpose: One physical model and one camera; movements at 1.1–3.1, 4.8–7.1 and 8.9–11.15. Interior holds at 3.1–4.8 and 7.1–8.9.

motion.name: clipped-line-entrance
motion.purpose: Scene text lines rise through clipped containers during camera holds.

motion.name: supporting-copy-entrance
motion.purpose: Paragraph/action entrances .3 timeline units after the headline entrance.

motion.name: floor-focus
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer table highlight with no pizza movement; disabled/reset below 700px or with reduced motion, re-enabled on desktop resize.

motion.name: optional-tour
motion.value: 20s maximum; minimum remaining duration 3s; ease none
motion.purpose: Optional scroll playback; wheel/touch/keyboard and a hidden document cancel it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Static intro view and ordinary page scrolling; no story playback/progress, pointer floor response, animated basket or filter rows.

narrative.overview:
FARO presents food as the centre of an evening together. Its established world combines a charcoal stage, warm paper, a tomato field, large literary headings and compact practical controls. The tone is warm and direct; space around the food and text supplies the confidence.

The built surface uses generous asymmetry, open menu rows and a single physical pizza model. Motion approaches and orbits that model, pausing for text. Below the scene, flat colour fields and a locally rendered still carry the same identity. This is the documented incumbent system, extracted from the finished presentation rather than a replacement direction.
keyCharacteristics: Large Literata headings with italic emphasis; Golos for useful details and controls.
Charcoal, warm paper and tomato surfaces with context-specific text contrast.
Sharp containers, thin rules and circular icon controls.
Real camera movement, two interior reading holds and clipped text entrances.
An explicitly fictional menu and a local demonstration basket.

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use warm paper and warm muted on charcoal; use charcoal on tomato and paper. Paper emphasis uses the darker tomato variant. Keep the scene's protective vignettes where food passes beneath text.

rules.name: The Tomato Field Rule
rules.body: Tomato can occupy a complete menu field. In dark sections it marks emphasis, progress and selected count; it is not restricted to a tiny accent.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Literata speaks in headings and food names. Golos handles navigation, explanation and actions. Italic emphasis stays within Literata.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep menu rows and story surfaces flat. Reserve interface elevation for the modal basket; let the food supply the visual depth.

dos: **Do** retain the charcoal, warm paper and tomato field roles, using darker tomato emphasis on paper.
**Do** pair Literata statements and dish names with Golos explanation, navigation and controls.
**Do** preserve open rows, thin rules, sharp surfaces and circular compact icon controls.
**Do** keep copy readable throughout camera movement and both interior holds, including narrow and short viewports.
**Do** support ordinary scrolling, keyboard access, visible focus, local still fallback and reduced motion.
**Do** preserve licensed asset attribution, font notices, embedded raster provenance and original source photographs.
**Do** identify the fictional menu, authored example prices and local basket export honestly.
donts: **Don't** replace the continuous camera approach and orbit with image swaps, crossfades or cuts.
**Don't** introduce section kickers, repeated icon cards, decorative glass or fabricated social proof into this established world.
**Don't** add real payment, order transmission, business claims or contact details without real product support.
**Don't** treat the restored texture as a new high-resolution scan or local frame measurements as a physical-device performance guarantee.
**Don't** make pointer-following background light active on narrow screens or under reduced motion.
